points.formation: Attributive clause, noun の, na-adjective な. Past event frequent, not obligatory; negative/stative causes allowed.
points.teachingChoice: Purpose already taught u01. Cause/outcome interpretation from context, not mechanically past versus present. Natural notices omit に. No blanket objective/proven causal claim.

points.formation: Plain/polite clause から; noun/na plain だから. Attributive clause ので; present noun/na なので, polite ですので; negative/past clauses as conjugated.
points.teachingChoice: Both can give reasons and requests in suitable contexts. Softer explanation versus direct justification are tendencies, not a unique-answer synonym gap or a truth test.
